content.title: Raised blood pressure estimate
content.body: Your blood pressure was estimated at 128/84 mmHg from the camera pulse scan, and your resting heart rate was around 72 bpm. This is a screening signal, not a diagnosis. A normal range sits below 120 over 80, so this reading suggests high blood pressure (raised pressure in your arteries). Please see a doctor within 7 days and ask for a cuff measurement to confirm it.
recommendations: Book a cuff blood pressure check with your doctor within 7 days.
Repeat this scan each morning for a week and record the values.
